dict.string: FinTrack's coach runs on a local Ollama model — nothing leaves your network. In the simulator it finds Ollama on the Mac automatically. On this iPhone it cannot: enter your Mac's address (for example 192.168.1.42) and make sure Ollama is listening beyond loopback. Left blank on a phone, the coach will say it has no server to talk to rather than pretending to be offline. Reinstalling the app clears this field.
